$clearCron.description: Clears an active cron, returns bool

$setCron.description: Executes code on a cron expression

expression.description: The cron expression to run it on, such as 0 9 * * 1-5

timezone.description: The zone to read the expression in, such as Europe/London

persist.description: Whether this cron is re-armed on startup, overriding cronConfig

maxOverdue.description: How stale a missed occurrence may be on startup before it is skipped

restoredTicksLimit.description: How many occurrences missed while down to replay on startup, overriding cronConfig

$findTimer.description: Returns every stored timer whose properties all match, as JSON

filters.description: property;value pairs, all of which have to match

$getAllTimers.description: Gets all existing timers from the database

kind.description: Only return timers of this kind

property.description: Return only this property of every timer, instead of all of them

separator.description: Join the properties with this, instead of listing them as JSON

$getTimer.description: Gets an existing timer from the database

kind.description: The kind of the timer to look for

name.description: The name of the timer to get

property.description: The property of the timer to return

$wipeTimers.description: Cancels every stored timer and wipes them from the database

$databaseFailReason.description: Returns why the databaseFail event's storage could not be opened

$timerData.description: Returns what an event's timer was scheduled with

property.description: The property to return, or every one of them as JSON

$timerDropReason.description: Returns why a timerDrop event's timer was thrown away without running

$timerOverdueBy.description: Returns how late a restored or dropped timer was, in ms

$timersDropped.description: Returns how many stored timers the timersReady event threw away

$timersRestored.description: Returns how many stored timers the timersReady event picked back up

$clearInterval.description: Clears an active interval, returns bool

$setInterval.description: Executes code after given duration until canceled

time.description: How long to wait for before running this code

persist.description: Whether this interval is re-armed on startup, overriding intervalConfig

maxOverdue.description: How stale a missed tick may be on startup before it is skipped, overriding intervalConfig

restoredTicksLimit.description: How many ticks missed while down to replay on startup, overriding intervalConfig

$clearTimeout.description: Clears an active timeout, returns bool

time.description: How long to wait for before running this code

persist.description: Whether this timeout is re-armed on startup, overriding timeoutConfig

maxOverdue.description: How late this timeout may be on startup before it is discarded, overriding timeoutConfig

$executeTimer.description: Runs a stored timer's code now without touching the timer itself, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to run

name.description: The name of the timer to run

$pauseTimer.description: Puts a stored timer on pause, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to pause

name.description: The name of the timer to pause

$rescheduleTimer.description: Moves a stored timer's schedule without scheduling it from scratch, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to move, which is what the schedule below means

name.description: The name of the timer to move

schedule.description: A delay for a timeout, a tick length for an interval, an expression for a cron

timezone.description: The zone to read a cron's new expression in. Left out keeps the one it had

$resumeTimer.description: Starts a paused timer again, from wherever its wait was left, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to resume

name.description: The name of the timer to resume

$timerExists.description: Checks whether there is a timer under this name at all, armed or stored, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to look for

name.description: The name of the timer to look for

$timerRunning.description: Checks whether a timer is running right now, returns bool

kind.description: The kind of the timer to look for

name.description: The name of the timer to look for

databaseConnect.description: Triggered when the timer storage opens

databaseFail.description: Triggered when the timer storage could not be opened

timerCancel.description: Triggered when a timer is cancelled by hand

timerDrop.description: Triggered when a stored timer is thrown away without running, with the reason in $timerDropReason

timerFire.description: Triggered when a timer's code runs: a timeout going off, or an interval ticking

timerRestore.description: Triggered when a stored timer is picked back up after a restart

timersReady.description: Triggered once startup has dealt with every stored timer

timerStart.description: Triggered when a timer is scheduled
